requirement_title: Fix IndexOutOfRangeException on closed generic struct from referenced assembly
requirement_text: The MsgPack00x analyzer throws IndexOutOfRangeException (surfaced as AD0001) when a [MessagePackObject] type has a field whose type is a closed generic struct declared in a referenced assembly. The analyzer must not crash; it must either resolve the formatter for the closed generic or report a proper diagnostic. Existing behaviour for generics declared in the same assembly must be unchanged.
verdict_reason: All receipts green except one surviving mutant on the new assembly-equality branch. Requirement tests written from REQ-2283 fail on base and pass on head. The surviving mutant means the change's own tests would not notice if the referenced-assembly path were inverted; a human should accept or request a test.
